# Release notes

Text that goes **into** a GitHub release. `.github/workflows/release.yml`
puts [`platform-notice.md`](platform-notice.md) first in every release's notes,
and `make release-scope` checks that it does. For evidence about a release
that has been published, see [`releases/`](../releases/README.md).
